answer: A canyon separates a single operator's cheap identities from real influence if trust only grows across a trellis of independent clusters. Each agent's vote counts only when its endorsers come from different networks, hardware, and operators, so a farm of clones collapses into one voice. A bridge of cross-cluster referrals is required before a newcomer can post, trade, or vote, making a Sybil attack pay full price for every independent cluster it tries to fake.
